required_fixes: RF1_DECISION_RULE_GAP: Frozen decision_rule has no bucket for observed pattern C1=PASS C2=FAIL C3=PASS C4=PASS C5=PASS. Spec declares SURVIVES requires C1-C5 all PASS, MIXED requires NOT C5, FALSIFIED requires NOT(C2 OR C3 OR C4), MEASUREMENT_INVALID requires NOT C1. None matches. Producer forces MIXED violating frozen rule (result.json outcome MIXED with C5 PASS). Derived artifact internally verdicts MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE (/tmp/opencode/oecd_analysis_results.json:decision_rule/verdict) contradicting result.json. Prereg must cover all 2^5 combinations before execution; gap is a preregistration defect.

RF2_C2_CONSTRUCT_IMPOSSIBLE: C2_DOMINANCE_INFORMATIVE requires 10-90% non-degenerate dominance but with exactly 2 recipes dominance is binary 0%/100% by definition (oecd_analysis_results.json:dominance_pairs all 0 or 100, result.json VN-1 admits). Hypothesis (a) was a priori unfalsifiable in this 2-recipe design. Reformulate C2 for 2-recipe comparisons (e.g., ranking reversal rate, density ratio) or add third recipe before claiming framework informativity.

RF3_C3_UNIT_MISMATCH: C3_CI_INFORMATIVE compares ranking CI width (rank units 1-4, oecd_analysis_results.json:ranking_cis) to density range (density units 0.54, aggregate_metrics.density_ranges). Producer check ci_width_normalized 0.018-0.073 < 0.541 (result.json VN-6) is trivially true because numerator and denominator are incommensurable scales and density range is inflated by cross-recipe 84.7-119x gap (vn-6). Must express both in same units or preregister normalization; disclose inflation.

RF4_C4_CHI_SQUARE_AND_N: C4 requires chi-square p<0.10 against uniform (spec.json decision_rule). Producer never computed p-value, only checked >=2 categories (report.md Decision Rule table, result.json M7). Recomputed chi-square 22.43 df=2 p~1e-05 is nominally <0.10 but based on wrong N: spec requires 21 task-definition pairs, producer classifies 14 task-recipe pairs (ranking_cis: 14 entries) with distribution MEDIUM 13 HIGH 1 LOW 0. Zero-cell violates chi-square assumptions and N mismatch violates measurement_validity #3.

RF5_NULL_CONTROL_THRESH_DRIFT_AND_DEGENERACY: spec.json positive_control/null_control thresholds (within 10% of 50% ; >=1.5x) differ from decision_rule C5 (within 15% ; >=1.3x) and result.json NC1 (gte_13x) without justification. Dominance null SD=0.0 trivially within 15% because shuffling 2 recipes preserves binary structure (result.json VN-5, oecd_analysis_results.json null_control null_sd 0). Dominance NC is degenerate and uninformative. CI width null ratio 125.3x (result.json M9) is driven by mixing near-zero canonical and 0.3-0.65 weighted regimes creating bimodal rankings, not proof of structure detection.

RF6_COINR_VALIDITY: measurement_validity #2 requires published versioned COINr PyPI or from-scratch with unit tests against OECD examples. Provenance shows custom /tmp/opencode/oecd_sensitivity_analysis.py (sha f3e1e66e) with no library version, no unit tests, and arbitrary per-task weighted formula (included/n_matching)*(bbox/1500) not mapped to OECD/COINr (analysis code recipe_per_task_weighted).

RF7_ARTIFACT_DURABILITY: Derived artifacts stored under /tmp/opencode/oecd_analysis_results.json and oecd_sensitivity_analysis.py are ephemeral; spec measurement_validity #1 requires reconstruction documented with exact code path and hash under research/experiments/ persistent path. Provenance hashes null for result.json/report.md/freeze.json.

RF8_BASELINE_COVERAGE: Control registry deviation - spec PC1_FRAMEWORK_EXECUTES and NC1_SHUFFLED_RECIPES vs producer controls NC1_SHUFFLED_RECIPES, NC2_C2_RECHECK, POSITIVE_CONTROL_DENSITY_CONSISTENCY. NC2 is invented (not frozen) and reports PASS without quantitative null means/p-values. B2_RANDOM_CLASSIFICATION threshold (chi-square p<0.05 vs decision_rule p<0.10) not reconciled; B1_BINARY_C2 recheck not quantitatively recomputed.

validity_findings.description: Frozen conjunctive rule leaves observed C-pattern (C1 PASS C2 FAIL C3 PASS C4 PASS C5 PASS) uncovered. Producer outcome MIXED requires NOT C5 but C5 passes (null_ci_gte_13x true, dominance within 15%). Derived JSON verdicts MEASUREMENT_INVALID. This is a preregistration coverage defect, not a scientific result.

With 2 recipes dominance is necessarily 0% or 100%. All 42 task-definition-recipe triples are degenerate (0 non-degenerate). Producer VN-1 correctly calls it framework limitation, but hypothesis required 0%<dominance<100% on 21 pairs, making F1 unfalsifiable in this design. This is construct failure not empirical discrimination.

C3 compares rank-width CI (1-4 ranks) to density range (0.41-0.64 density). Normalized CI width 0.018-0.073 is derived after ad-hoc division by 100*mean_range, guaranteeing pass because numerator small. VN-6 admits range inflated by cross-recipe scale difference. Measurement not comparable as preregistered.

validity_findings.description: Classification entropy 0.371 bits (normalized 0.234) with 13 MEDIUM 1 HIGH shows near-zero discrimination despite technically >=2 categories. Spec requires chi-square p<0.10 never computed; producer used category count proxy. N=14 vs frozen 21; thresholds 25th/75th percentiles are data-dependent, not preregistered absolute thresholds, undermining C4 falsifiability (prereg sec 16 validity threat 6).

Null dominance mean 50% SD 0.0 (shuffled) is identical to original by construction with 2 recipes; shuffling preserves binary structure. Control result PASS is tautological, not evidence framework detects real recipe structure (producer note: uninformative with 2 recipes). Spec null_control expected degenerate to be detectable.

No OECD/COINr library used, no unit tests against OECD examples. Custom Python implements expected density averaging over 1000 iterations for canonical but per-task weighted normalizes by bbox/1500 arbitrary constant, introducing structural gap (119x ratio) not justified as OECD sensitivity mapping (interpretive analogy per do_not_assume[1]).

All densities computed on locatable_sample capped at 20 (provenance raw_evidence sha da30bd05, dom_stats linksCount 393 vs locatable_sample 20). Truncation underestimates densities for tasks with 21-82 locatable elements (VN-4). Results explicitly bounded to truncated-first-20; no extrapolation to full-DOM and parent next_question (full-DOM C2) remains blocked.

claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED: On truncated-first-20 data (7 tasks: 3 product_listing, 3 detail, 1 cart, 3 definitions, locatable_sample cap 20) the canonical per-iteration (p=0.5) and per-task weighted recipes occupy distinct density regimes (cross-recipe gap ~0.50 absolute, 85-120x ratio, rank correlations >0.98 within recipe). The OECD/COINr dominance framework as operationalized with exactly 2 recipes is NOT informative for MIXED handling via dominance pairs (all degenerate 0%/100%, F1 triggered) and provides only narrow, heavily concentrated classification (13/14 MEDIUM, entropy 0.37 bits). CI-width and null-dominance controls are compromised by unit mismatch and degeneracy (see V3/V5). No principled OECD-based MIXED outcome decision rule (dominance pairs, ranking CIs, sensitivity classes) is established for the 2-recipe SPIDER density problem at any ceiling. Framework limitation is demonstrated, not a validated decision rule. The blocked next question (full-DOM C2 FALSE/TRUE reversal persistence) remains open; product lane may NOT use this experiment to justify recipe choice. Revalidation with 3+ recipes, unit-consistent CIs, chi-square reporting, and full locatable_sample required before any SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST at even truncated ceiling.
